current_activity: division command post at Pont-à-Mousson after landing in France
notes: Event date: 14 January 1945 (CMH ETO-OB lists the 8th Armored Division command post at Pont-à-Mousson, Meurthe-et-Moselle, on 14 January; the same page gives arrival on the Continent on 6 January 1945 and first elements in combat on 19 January 1945). Event definition: a CMH list places the division headquarters at Pont-à-Mousson; the division is first in the dataset here, assigned to Fifteenth Army and attached to Third Army in the CMH table. Relationship: Third Army attached (from 12 Jan 45 to 31 Jan 45, CMH table); Fifteenth Army assigned (from 8 Jan 45 to 22 Jan 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 2 Jan 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). Location: Pont-à-Mousson (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R516 p. 495: listed 14 January 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Pont-à-Mousson. Event support: moderate (one official table). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date).
